name: abc-local-ai-intro
description: A 10-minute Marp introduction to local AI for ABC

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist/assets && cp assets/*.png dist/assets/ && marp deck.md --theme theme.css --html --allow-local-files --output dist/index.html && marp deck.md --theme theme.css --pdf --allow-local-files --output dist/local-ai-in-ten-minutes.pdf
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name abc-local-ai-intro
